templates.title: FeedKeeper
templates.description: Lightweight RSS reader and remote MCP server: one Node process and one SQLite file, with a newspaper-style reader, full-text search and sync for native apps.
templates.note: Open the web interface on port 3000 after the stack is up and create the first account there. Set PUBLIC_URL to the address you open FeedKeeper at.

env.name: SESSION_SECRET
env.label: Session secret
env.description: A long random secret (32 or more characters) that signs session cookies. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: Public URL
env.description: The address you open FeedKeeper at, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://feeds.example.org

env.name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
env.label: Allow sign-up
env.description: Whether new people can register themselves. Keep false on an instance reachable from the internet.
